title: CancelGateDecision
description: The human (or automated) decision that resumes a held cancel-and-refund proposal on apa.orders.decisions, matched back to its proposal on apa.orders.pending-decisions by correlationId. APPROVE performs the cancel-and-refund side effect exactly once; REJECT terminates the proposal as REJECTED_BY_USER with no side effect, ever. Registered in Apicurio under the BACKWARD compatibility rule, so a later chapter may only add optional fields to this shape.

correlationId.description: matches the correlationId on the held apa.orders.pending-decisions proposal

decidedBy.description: who or what made the call; unset for a system/automated decision
